title: Minerals & Such
description: This mod adds a multiple new items, tools, and ores to the game.
body:
# Minerals & Such

## About
Minerals & Such adds new ores to Minecraft that feel like vanilla. You’ll find them while exploring caves, mountains, and other places as you mine around the world.

## Ores
There are 4 new ores to find: **Platinum**, **Mica**,  **Osmium**, and **Topaz**. Each one comes with its own tools and advancements.

## Gear & Tools
Each mineral has its own set of tools with different strengths. **Topaz** tools are about as strong as iron, **Mica** is a bit rarer and slightly stronger, **Platinum** is rarer still, resistant to fire and lava, and stronger than diamond, and **Osmium** is very rare, tough to get, and stronger than netherite.

## Gameplay Feel
The mod fits naturally into Minecraft without changing how it plays. There’s just a few extra things to come across and enjoy while exploring underground.
